about: The mutant runner shares the capped-child classifier with proclimit.

mutants.name: embed-duplicate-ledger-anchor
mutants.rule: Every ledger edit applies exactly once at HEAD, including literal template edits.

mutants.name: gcoom-mutants-text-only
mutants.rule: A capped mutant child's span-queue allocation fault has reason memory.

mutants.name: ert-suite-tags-dropped
mutants.rule: A suite with build tags builds its test binary with them, so a mutant of a tagged file is covered and judged.

mutants.name: ert-suite-tags-unfiltered
mutants.rule: A mutant is judged only by the suites built with its own tags.
